injection_strategy: Removed the early-exit check `if (signal.aborted) { abort(self); return }` from addSignal. Without this check, passing an already-aborted AbortSignal does not cause the handler to abort immediately. Instead, the listener is registered on the already-fired signal. Since AbortController only fires the abort event once, the listener never fires and the request proceeds normally.
expected_failure_summary: Pre-aborted signals do not abort requests immediately. A request created with an already-aborted signal completes normally (or hangs) instead of immediately failing with RequestAbortedError.
calibration_notes: Medium: model must find addSignal in lib/api/abort-signal.js and add the missing signal.aborted early-exit guard.
